subject: Scheduling: HelionGrid demo + IT/security pre-call — availability mosaic

From: Tom Bradley <tom.bradley@heliongrid.com>
To: sales@redwood.ai; avery.johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 18:07:00 -0400
Subject: Interested in Redwood — scheduling demo

Hi Redwood team,

We just tried the self-serve flow and had a few follow-ups. We're early evaluating inference runtimes for an internal pilot (HelionGrid). Can we schedule a demo next week? Key stakeholders: myself (Product), Laura Singh (Head of IT & Security), and a solutions engineer if possible.

Constraints: Laura is only available after 15:00 CET (because of on-call rotation). We're in London (BST). Prefer a 45-min slot so we can do a brief technical pre-call + demo.

Thanks,
Tom Bradley
Product Lead, HelionGrid

Attachments: none
From: avery.johnson@redwood.ai
To: Tom Bradley <tom.bradley@heliongrid.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — scheduling demo

Tom — thanks for the note and for running the self-serve flow. Excited to connect. I've looped in Sean (AE) and Neha (SE) so we can align on timing and technical scope.

Proposed approach:
- 15-min IT/security pre-call with Laura + Neha (technical deep-dive / SSO/network questions)
- 45-min product + technical demo (AE + SE + customer stakeholders)

Proposed windows next week (all times shown in BST / London local):
- Tue 20 Oct — 16:30–17:30 BST (good for SE + AE)
- Wed 21 Oct — 15:00–16:00 BST (blocks for Laura)
- Thu 22 Oct — 17:00–18:00 BST (fallback)

If none work, send 2–3 windows that do and we'll match. I've attached an abbreviated IT checklist that typically helps Laura see required items ahead of time.

Attachment: heliongrid-it-checklist.xlsx (summary: SSO, allowed IP ranges, data retention questions)

Best,
Avery Johnson
Sr. SDR, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123

Avery, Sean, Neha — thanks, that plan looks good.

Laura and I looked at the slots: Wed 21 Oct 15:00 BST works best for the full demo. For the IT pre-call, could we do 14:30–14:45 BST right before it? Laura confirmed she can do 14:30–16:00 on Wed and prefers the shorter pre-call.

A couple of notes for the SE:
- Our environment: hybrid on-prem + GCP; we use Okta for SSO and have an internal JumpBox for RPCs.
- Network: non-prod inference will be in a restricted subnet; we'll need a short checklist to confirm required ports and any cert exchange.

I'll accept the Calendly option if you send one. Otherwise, put the invites on Sean's calendar and include a bridge.

Tom
Product Lead, HelionGrid

Thanks Tom — glad Wed 21 Oct 15:00 BST works. I've put together a short technical runbook for the pre-call so we can use 14:30–14:45 as suggested.

Plan and asks for the pre-call (14:30–14:45 BST):
- Quick intros (2 min)
- Confirm Okta SSO flow and whether a test service account can be provisioned (5–7 min)
- Validate network access: Which IP ranges will be opened for the pilot? Any cert pins or proxy layers? (5–7 min)
- Immediate blockers / next steps (2–3 min)

I'll attach the runbook and include the bullet checklist in the calendar invite. Can you confirm whether Laura prefers Google Meet or a PST dial-in bridge? We have both.

Attachment: precall-runbook.md

Sean — I'll need you to send the demo calendar invite (45 min) and include the 15-min pre-call as a separate invite that links to the same meeting room (we usually do a 15-min private pre-call then let Laura and Tom stay for the demo).

Looking forward — I will also add a short HubSpot note (HubSpot-Contact-987654) with the pre-call checklist so we can track follow-ups.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
